calculate_bmi.description: Calculate body mass index from a weight in kilograms or pounds and a height in metres, centimetres or inches, and get the health category the result falls in: Underweight, Normal weight, Overweight or Obesity. No API key required.
calculate_bmi.name: calculate_bmi

parameters.description: Body weight, for example 87.9 in kilograms or 194 in pounds. Choose the unit below.
parameters.name: weight

parameters.description: Optional. What the weight is in. Kilograms by default.
parameters.name: weight_unit

parameters.description: Height, for example 1.75 in metres, 175 in centimetres or 69 in inches. Choose the unit below.
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: Optional. What the height is in. Metres by default. For feet and inches, give the height in inches: 5 ft 9 in is 69.
parameters.name: height_unit

bmi.description: The calculated body mass index, rounded to three decimal places.

category.description: The WHO health category for the BMI: Underweight (below 18.5), Normal weight (18.5 up to 25), Overweight (25 up to 30) or Obesity (30 and above).

height.description: The height, in metres, the BMI was calculated from, converted if it was given in another unit.

weight.description: The weight, in kilograms, the BMI was calculated from, converted if it was given in pounds.

description: Calculate body mass index from a weight and a height, in metric or imperial units, and get the health category it falls in: Underweight, Normal weight, Overweight or Obesity. No account or API key required.
